ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low intensity (dark) pixels dominate approximately 90-95% of the visible surface area, with sparse, high-intensity (white) pixel clusters distributed as speckling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Discontinuous high-contrast white focal spots and fine-grained mottling are scattered across the distal and central regions of both lobes, with no large contiguous geometric bands present.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with an acute internal angle approximately 35-45 degrees relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by irregular jagged peaks and shallow valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex sweep towards the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous roughly circular white high-contrast clusters, likely barnacle attachment scars, concentrated on the outer distal margins and scattered across the interior surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible, notably a diagonal mark on the left lobe and horizontal streaks on the right lobe distal tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white mottling and punctate scarring patterns across the ventral surface; no major amputations or trailing edge deformities detected.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced concentration of white pigmentation along the extreme outer edge of the right lobe compared to the left lobe.
